notes.title: Colorizing - A lot of changes
notes.content:
Hello there!
As promised, I'm back with an update. In this huge update I've implemented many suggestions from users and also added 40 new images. I hope you like it :)

- Added 40 new images
- Dark themes added
- Ability to switch gameplay to classic mode
- You can change fullscreen mode
- Disable autofollow camera for gamepads
